title: cheilanthes marsupianthes
intro: Cheilanthes marsupianthes, commonly known as Rock fern or Wall fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential to act as an antimicrobial and antifungal agent. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes marsupianthes are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and efficacy of Cheilanthes marsupianthes as a medicinal plant.
